reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 16 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The source note's lower area is largely blank, while the returned native note has two additional distinct gray scuff/mark clusters on its lower-right side. Remove these added lower marks and restore the source's original blank lower-paper footprint while retaining the existing upper gray-mark rows.
entries.positive_observation: The thick purple patterned wrapped head covering retains its silhouette with dark swept-back hair visible at the forehead. Thin dark arched brows, one serious closed mouth, a smooth chin and no facial hair or separate glasses remain. The frontal direct-gaze pose and soft frontal lighting remain. The dark burgundy-purple blouse/jacket has small pale motifs, a dark central neckline knot/bow and exactly one strand of white beads. The rounded chin meets a short broad collar transition. The complete thin dark frame and opaque dark blue-charcoal backplate remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The two added lower-right note marks are the separate rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact construction of the purple crown wrap, tiny textile motifs and note glyphs are not fully resolvable at source scale. No rejection is based on those unresolved details; the two independent lower-right gray scuff clusters are clearly visible in the native note crop.
